preconditions: Owned pending transaction, independently bound base/source bytes and native local Linux filesystem.
steps: Read journal status without normal model loading.
Under a held recovery lock, compare the complete live base inventory and preserve all original preparation bytes in an immutable audit on discard.
Exercise real publication, partial work, forged metadata, concurrent changes and durability failures; verify unchanged normative data and preserved evidence.

In separate fresh writer and recovery processes, reconstruct the prepared basis from product-persisted inputs, diagnose it, authorize discard under a new native lock, and verify original evidence, zero native normative writes and successful next-writer access.

oracle.requirement_contract: `specroad recover status` MUSS Zustand, Journalhash, Basiswurzel, erwartete Zielwurzel, veröffentlichte Einträge und zulässige Recovery-Aktionen jeder unvollständigen Transaktion ausgeben.
oracle.scope: Existing retained-preflight building/prepared discard and its protection boundaries remain supported. AUDIT-REC-05.W additionally reconstructs the complete prepared basis from current project files and persisted profile/resource selection, without a Change Plan or regular model load. Both normal writer exit and audited native takeover after actual process death are covered; independent full-root calculation, byte preservation, immutable audit/receipt and next-writer access are observed.

open_items: AUDIT-REC-05.R must extend restart reconstruction to building/interrupted preparation and interrupted discard completion; AUDIT-REC-05.C retains the resulting behavior while consolidating structure. Legacy journals without persisted selection are not silently upgraded. The comprehensive crash/environment matrix and general CLI integration are not claimed.
Public recovery CLI integration and automatic transaction preflight are not claimed; automatic preflight remains in 5.t.
